description.value: Mega Donair is a Port Moody fast-food restaurant established in 2011, specializing in donairs with freshly baked pita and an expanded topping selection including cucumber, spicy carrots, parsley, and feta cheese. It serves halal chicken and beef alongside lamb and falafel, and claims to offer the largest donair size in British Columbia. Catering and limited-radius delivery are available for larger orders.
